per_session_tokens_saved_descriptions.formula: (tools/list compact chars before - after moving description text to a skill) / 4

per_session_tokens_saved_with_output_sch.formula: same, also dropping outputSchema; counts only for clients that put outputSchema in context

per_workflow_build_tokens_saved.formula: (export response bytes today - with signed URL) / 4 x 1 export per build (observed)

landing_first_load_bytes_saved_gzip.formula: gzip -9 size of the PostHog chunk, moved off the first load

landing_bytes_saved_by_brotli.formula: landing JS+CSS gzip -9 minus brotli -q11, both computed locally
